text: Assumption: The function is interruptible by higher-priority tasks — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The function is interruptible by higher-priority tasks — is this correct?
norm: the function is interruptible by higher priority tasks
assumption: The function is interruptible by higher-priority tasks.
rationale: According to the specification, the call occurs from a preemptive operating system during idle without other pending tasks.

original.text: Annahme: Unterbrechbarkeit durch höher priorisierte Tasks — trifft das zu?
original.rationale: Der Aufruf erfolgt laut Spezifikation aus einem präemptiven Betriebssystem bei Leerlauf ohne andere anstehende Tasks.
